title: Onelegged sailor crutched himself round MacConnell’s
html_source:
In this section we follow the one-legged sailor from the first section as he walks down Eccles Street. He receives a coin from a lady and passes by Stephen Dedalus' sisters, Katey and Boody. Molly opens a window and throws a coin out to the sailor. The Dedalus sisters give the sailor the coin.

Note, in this sentence, the use of anthimeria: the noun ‘crutches’ is transformed into a verb, and used as an economical way of describing the physical movements of the onelegged sailor.
